'''Gran''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] [[Homeworld|native]] to the [[planet]] [[Kinyen]],<ref name="Knights of Fate" /> but had colonies on many worlds such as [[Malastare]],<ref name="Special Mods" /> [[Hok]],<ref name="CE" /> and [[Varkana]].<ref name="The Missing Agent">{{Resistance|The Missing Agent}}</ref> Identifiable by their three [[eye]]s and goat-like snouts, Gran also had small antennae-like nubs on the tops of their head and thick, bulky hands that could either have six large digits or five suction-cup-like digits.<ref name="Gran" /> Members of this species included the [[Podracer]] [[pilot]] [[Mawhonic]],<ref name="Mawhonic" /> the [[Galactic Republic]] [[senator]]s [[Ask Aak]],<ref name="Ask Aak">{{Databank|ask-aak|Ask Aak}}</ref> [[Philo]],<ref name="Hostage Crisis" /> [[Kharrus]],<ref name="The Gungan General" /> as well as the criminal [[Ree-Yees]], who worked for [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="AEYNTK" />

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:Ree-Yees-SWCT.png|thumb|left|150px|Ree-Yees, a Gran with five-digit hands.]]
Gran were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[humanoid]] [[species]] identified by their goat-like faces and three [[eye]]s. Their heads were topped with four antennae-like nubs, two of which were short and straight, and another set that were longer and curved. Gran could have diverse builds, generally falling into two distinct body shapes, one being fat-bottomed and rotund at their mid-section<ref name="Episode I" /> while the other being skinnier and have proportions similar to a [[human]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The former variant also had hands that featured six slender digits,<ref name="Episode I" /> though the latter type generally possessed either smaller, human-like hands or fatter hands with thick digits that ended in flat suction-cup-like appendages.<ref name="Episode VI" /> Gran had two [[stomach]]s<ref name="CE" /> and could live for several [[Standard century|centuries]].<ref name="HRA 3">[[The High Republic Adventures (2021) 3|''The High Republic Adventures'' (2021) 3]]</ref>

==Society and culture==
Gran originated from the planet [[Kinyen]],<ref name="KAOPITMR">{{EncyclopediaCite|Kashyyyk and Other Planets in the Mid Rim}}</ref> though  migrated and adapted to colonize many worlds including [[Malastare]],<ref name="Special Mods" /> [[Hok]], and [[Varkana]].<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> The Gran who remained on Kinyen primarily sustained an economy centered on agriculture and livestock.<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> On Kinyen, the houses on each wedge-shaped farm were typically situated at the narrowest point of the property, fostering a sense of community among the inhabitants.<ref name="Knights of Fate" />  Many farmers on Kinyen practiced a religion called [[Doellinism]].<ref name="Knights of Fate" /> [[Houjix]] were rumored to be a popular pet on Kiynen.<ref name="Alien Archive" />

[[File:Malastare_Delagates_TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|The Gran delegates of Malastare]]
Kinyen was represented by the Gran in the [[Galactic Senate|Republic Senate]], with [[Kharrus]] and then [[Philo]]<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> having served as senators at different points during the [[Clone Wars]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis">{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}}</ref><ref name="The Gungan General">{{TCW|The Gungan General}}</ref> Although the [[Dug]] were native to [[Malastare]] and controlled the planets natural fuel reserves,<ref name="Special Mods" /> it was the Gran that represented the world in the [[Galactic Senate]]<ref name="Alien Archive" /><ref name="KAOPITMR" /> via the [[Congress of Malastare]]<ref name="Episode I" /> after the [[Galactic Republic]] awarded them ownership of the planet in the [[Gran Protectorate Act]].<ref name="Special Mods" /> Ultimately, however, at least two Dugs were able to join the ranks of the Congress of Malastare.<ref name="Card">{{SWU|set=Secrets of Power|cardname=Congress of Malastare|link=1629192496|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/3yLBy}}</ref>

==History==
During the [[Old Republic-era]], the Gran embarked on an [[Gran expansion|expansion effort]], during which Gran colonists [[Colonization of Malastare|arrived on and began the colonization of]] the planet Malastare. There, they met great resistance from the native Dugs in the fierce [[Dug-Gran conflict/Canon|Dug-Gran conflict]]. In the end, the Gran faction held greater sway with the Galactic Republic and took effective control of Malastare under the [[Gran Protectorate Act]].<ref name="Special Mods" />

==Gran in the galaxy==
===Jedi and politicians===
[[File:JediKnight-CM.png|thumb|left|250px|A Gran Jedi Knight]]
At least one Gran was known to have served as a [[Jedi Knight]].<ref name="KAOPITMR" /><ref name="CovertJediKnight">{{Destiny|set=Covert Missions|cardname=Jedi Knight|link=http://www.cardgamedb.com/index.php/starwarsdestiny/star-wars-destiny/_/covert-missions/jedi-knight-r1685}}</ref> Several Gran held notable positions within the political sphere of the Galactic Republic, including Malastare politician [[Ainlee Teem]],<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> Malastare's senator [[Aks Moe]], who served until his assassination,<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> and [[Ask Aak]], who succeeded Moe.<ref name="KAOPITMR" /><ref name="Ask Aak">{{Databank|ask-aak|Ask Aak}}</ref> During 32 BBY,<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> when a [[Invasion of Naboo|crisis on Naboo]] was brought to the senate's attention, Moe agreed with the accused [[Trade Federation]] representative [[Lott Dod]] that a survey should be conducted in order to validate the [[Naboo]] [[queen]]'s claims. When the queen instead led the Senate into a [[Vote of No Confidence]] against [[Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum]], Teem attempted to run for Chancellor but lost to [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]].<ref name="Episode I" /> During the intergalactic Clone Wars,<ref name="The Gungan General" /> Senator Kharrus of Kinyen<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> led a ransom mission to the planet [[Florrum]], but was [[Death|killed]] when his [[shuttle]] was shot down by [[pirate]]s.<ref name="The Gungan General" /> Philo, who replaced Kharrus, was murdered by the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane]] when Bane [[Senate hostage crisis|took members of the senate hostage]] in a bid to free the imprisoned [[Hutt]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure|Ziro]].<ref name="Hostage Crisis" />

In [[14 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''Darth Vader'' (2017) 20 to [[14 BBY]].</ref> A Gran [[senator]] of Malastare, [[Maklooq]],<ref name="TRAFOTGE">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> was killed when a [[speeder]] fell on her and her [[Marriage|partner]] while they were in a park on [[Coruscant]] during a [[Coruscant Incident|fight]] between [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] and two [[Inquisitorius|Inquisitors]].<ref name="Dark Lord 20">[[Darth Vader (2017) 20|''Darth Vader'' (2017) 20]]</ref><ref name="TRAFOTGE" /> [[Unidentified Gran senator|One Gran senator]] active during the [[New Republic Era]] was seated on the [[Senate Oversight Committee]] during [[Ahsoka Tano]]'s [[quest to find Ezra Bridger]]<ref name="Part Three">{{Ahsoka|Part Three: Time to Fly}}</ref> in 9 ABY.<ref name="Timeline date">{{AhsokaSeriesDate}}</ref>

===Civilian and criminal spheres===
[[File:Mawhonic-DB.png|thumb|right|250px|Mawhonic, a pod-racer from Hok]]
One famous Gran was the [[Podracer (profession)|Podracer]] [[Mawhonic]] from Hok, who flew in the 32 BBY [[Boonta Eve Classic]] [[Podracing|Podrace]].<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> Mawhonic flew a green Podracer that was maintained by a Gran pit crew, but despite a strong starting position, Mawhonic crashed in the first lap of the race due to the aggressive, combative racing style of the Dug pilot [[Sebulba]].<ref name="Episode I" />

Several Gran were known to have worked for the [[crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]].<ref name="KAOPITMR" /> When Jabba's son [[Rotta]] was kidnapped during the Clone Wars, Jabba hired a Gran [[bounty hunter]] to retrieve the Huttlet. Along with several other bounty hunters, the Gran made it to the planet [[Teth]], but was decapitated by the kidnappers and had their head returned to Jabba.<ref name="TCWFilm">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref> By the year [[4 ABY]],<ref name="EP6Date">{{FilmDate|VI}}</ref> the Gran [[Ree-Yees]] became a member of Jabba's court and cared for Jabba's pet [[frog-dog]] [[Buboicullaar]].<ref name="Jabba's Place One Shot">[[Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace 1]]</ref> and was killed onboard the ''[[Khetanna]]'', Jabba's sail barge, when it was destroyed by the [[Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker]] during the [[Rescue of Han Solo]].<ref name="Episode VI">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:ReeYees-static-mask-and-hands.png|thumb|left|250px|The hands and static mask prop for Ree-Yees]]
The Gran species originated from the character Ree-Yees,<ref name="AEYNTK" /> who first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']].<ref name="Episode VI" /> The character was designed by [[Chris Walas]], who crafted various maquettes for the creature shop during the production of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']] .<ref name="RegalMaquettePage">{{WebCite|url=https://regalrobot.com/shop/star-wars/starwars-busts-statues-collectibles/ree-yees-concept-maquette-replica-chris-walas-signature-edition/|text=Ree-Yees™ Concept Maquette Replica – Chris Walas Signature Edition|author=Regal Robot|archivedate =20230127162915}}</ref> This initial version of the design was realized as a maquette sculpted by Walas.<ref name="Archeology2017">{{YouTube|video=RWw8-s_a0vM|text=Star Wars: Return of the Jedi - Cantina Archeology Part 3: Behind The Scenes of Jabba's Palace|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref><ref name="Archeology2025">{{YouTube|video=kzWqHmjdZZ0|text=BTS - Return of the Jedi's Creatures | Full Panel #indianacomicconvention #starwarshistory #rotj|channel=@FanXComicConventions|name=FanX Comic Conventions}}</ref>  The creature was originally nicknamed Three Eyes<ref name="Archeology2025" /> and is referred to in a costume sketch by [[Nilo Rodis-Jamero]] by the same name.<ref name="ArtOf">''[[The Art of Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi]]''</ref> This concept was taken and turned into<ref name="RegalMaquettePage" /> two<ref name="ChroniclesOT">[[Star Wars Chronicles]]</ref> full scale rubber masks for the film.<ref name="RegalMaquettePage" /> one static mask was made for background shots and one was made with wires which could manipulate the eyes of the mask.<ref name="ChroniclesOT" /> [[Dave Carson]] sculpted at least one of these masks.<ref name="Archeology2025" /> The masks were worn by [[Paul Springer]] in the palace and sail barge scenes during filming, though another extra [[Richard Bonehill]] also wore the mask for background shots on the sail barge.<ref name="ROTJActors">{{Rebelscum|subdomain=forum|url=threads/rotj-history-gerald-homes-creature-info.1069050/post-18528427|text=ROTJ History: Gerald Home's Creature Info.|author=[[Gerald Home]]|date=2010-8-16|quote=As I wrote in my original post, and Paul has now confirmed, he was Ree Yees in all the Jabba's Palace scenes, and in the still photos of Jabba's creatures - and that includes the one in Jabba's Palace where most of us are behind Jabba. (I'm at the very back of the group - tall people and creatures always get put in the back.) I didn't mention Ree Yees on the Sail Barge in my original post, because I knew there was some "controversy" over this issue: I distinctly remember Paul as Ree Yees on the Sail Barge, but in recent years many fans, and Tim Dry, have told me that Richard Bonehill was at one time on the Sail Barge as Ree Yees, so I didn't want to mention this subject until after Paul gave you the exact facts, which only he really knows. Now that he's told you, I can confirm what he said: I saw him as Ree Yees on the Sail Barge, and Tim Dry saw Richard B there too. As several of you have said, that means Richard can legitimately sign Ree Yees photos on the Sail Barge, as can Paul, but only Paul is entitled to sign Ree Yees in any photo connected with Jabba's Palace - not that I'm trying to be a policeman here! I'm merely trying to achieve historical accuracy.|archivedate=20211023072701}}</ref>

[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']] featured an updated animatronic Gran design with dynamic lips, mouth, eyes, and eyestalks, with at least two of these masks having been made for the film.<ref name="CreatureFilmWebdoc">{{SW|url=video/this-is-a-creature-film|serieslink=Making Episode I Webdocs|text=Part 5: This is a Creature Film}}</ref> The masks were used for [[Mawhonic]] and [[Aks Moe]].<ref name="Episode I" /> These masks were reused throughout both [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref> and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III Revenge of the Sith'']].<ref name="Episode III">{{Film|III}}</ref> Additionally, this new dynamic design scrapped the armadillo-like suctioned hands, the new mold bearing little resemblance to the one used in [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']],<ref name="Episode VI" /><ref name="Episode I" /> though the aforementioned suctioned hands would later reappear in the [[Part Three: Time to Fly|third episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Ahsoka]]''.<ref name="Part Three" />
